entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: State where a 5GMM context has been established and one or more PDU sessions may be established at the UE.

entities.name: Non-initial registration procedure
entities.description: Registration procedure including normal registration update and periodic registration update that can be initiated in 5GMM-REGISTERED state.

entities.name: Service request procedure
entities.description: Procedure that can be initiated by the UE in 5GMM-REGISTERED state.

entities.name: Periodic registration update procedure
entities.description: Procedure that cannot be initiated by UE in 5GMM-REGISTERED state over non-3GPP access.

entities.name: 5GMM context
entities.description: Context that has been established when UE is in 5GMM-REGISTERED state.

entities.name: PDU session
entities.description: One or more PDU sessions that may be established at the UE in 5GMM-REGISTERED state.

entities.name: Non-3GPP access
entities.description: Condition where UE is connected via non-3GPP access network.

relations.description: 5GMM-REGISTERED state indicates that a 5GMM context has been established.
5GMM-REGISTERED state may have one or more PDU sessions established.
Non-initial registration procedure can be initiated in 5GMM-REGISTERED state.
Service request procedure can be initiated in 5GMM-REGISTERED state.
When UE is in 5GMM-REGISTERED state over non-3GPP access, it shall not initiate periodic registration update procedure.
